title: Portal: create a personal token
summary: The step after Create personal token on Account → Packages: a Name ('Work laptop'), Expires after (90 days by default) and the date it gives, then Cancel and Create.
compare: 2026-10-20 shell (PX-35, BR-lockups): Polaris Locker, not Polaris Key (data-brand="locker", the trimmed outlined Locker lockup, no Key mark, no key.plrs.im footer); no header Activate (the account menu's first item); no footer (Help and Privacy are in the account menu); the docked Library · Discover phone bar, neither tab current on Account; US dates. Reconciled with the build's create dialog (PackagesCard.tsx CreateDialog, F-33).

Title 'Create a personal token', then the build's line 'Reads every package your licenses include, now and for apps you license later. Read-only.' It replaces the four glyph facts and the 'New packages token' title.
Name is the first field, focused, here 'Work laptop' (placeholder 'Laptop, CI build server…'); an empty Create says 'Give it a name.'
Expires after (build, F-33's 'mockups to adopt'): 30, 90 or 180 days or 1 year, 90 by default, then 'Expires Jan 5, 2027.' under it.
A sign-in older than 5 minutes asks for a fresh one inside the dialog (StepUpInline) and keeps the name; at the token limit the refusal says how many and to revoke one first.
Cancel (outline) and the ink primary 'Create', which leads to packages.portal-token.
Phone: the kit's bottom sheet with the buttons full width, the primary on top.

Dialog (ui/Dialog outside the console, kit .dialog.plain): no head band, no rule under the head, no 3 px top edge; the title and its one muted line in the head; the scrim black at 60 %, no blur (build; the B4 head band and the blurred scrim are the console's).
Portal v2 (B2, B12): the one filled primary is ink; weights 400/500/600.

designReview.reviewer: 4 UX designers, triaged by a lead designer
designReview.verdict: Spacing and copy trimmed per the multi-review triage; see findings.

findings.issue: Sentences repeat a fact said in the sibling dialog.
findings.resolution: Helper 'Name the machine, to tell tokens apart'; 'Expires Jan 5, 2027 (90 days)'; 'Your other tokens keep working' removed (the revoke dialog carries it).
